title: Figure records
error: Could not read or save figure records. Try again.
chooseTarget: Choose a target journal and width to redraw at journal size.
checkMismatch: The target, width or figure kind differs from the last check. Run it again.
journalRules.limit: Check the latest guidance before submission. This check does not decide publication eligibility.
policy.allowed: The target journal allows this figure kind.
policy.disclose: The target journal requires disclosure of AI use.
policy.forbidden: The target journal does not allow this figure kind.
policy.permission: Prior permission from the target journal is required.
policy.unknown: The target journal policy for this kind is unverified.
disclosure.limit: The disclosure is an draft, not reviewed. Copy it under View record and review its purpose and guidance before submission.
prefilled: Instructions are in the chat composer. Edit them before sending.
incomplete: Some input records are missing or exceed the trace limit.
noChat: Open a chat for the instructions and try again.

checkNote.artwork-unclassified: Artwork type (photo, combination, line art) not set. Thresholds in that order
checkNote.plot-metadata: Measured from the plot's saved information
checkNote.rainbow-like: Looks like a rainbow (jet) colour map; automatic estimate
checkNote.no-hue-ramp: No rainbow colour map found; colour map name not checked
checkNote.cvd-previews: Three colour-vision previews; review them yourself
checkNote.cvd-vector: Check vector figures with a raster copy
